basics.name: Nguyen Vu Huy
basics.label: Data Scientist · AI Engineer
basics.summary: Data scientist and AI engineer working on natural language processing, retrieval-augmented generation, and applied machine learning. My work spans the full path from data to a deployed model: exploration and feature engineering, training and evaluation, and serving the result behind an API. I hold a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence from FPT University and have published peer-reviewed work on low-resource machine translation and object detection.

work.name: TPBank
highlights: Queried and explored the UAT database with SQL to understand banking data structures.
Applied the CRISP-DM methodology to real-world data science workflows in banking.
Worked through data profiling, data quality assessment, and preprocessing on prior production codebases.

work.name: FPT Software
highlights: Built a retrieval-augmented generation chatbot with Python, Qdrant, and FastAPI for knowledge retrieval.
Contributed to a Java-based movie ticket booking application in an Agile Scrum team.

courses: 300+ sessions covering mathematics for AI, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, NLP, and generative AI.
Contributed to the AI VIET NAM Research Group, which produced the publications listed here.

publications.name: Low-Resource English–Vietnamese Translation: A Comparative Study of mBART-50 and NLLB
Attention-Enhanced YOLO-Nano for Adverse Weather Object Detection

projects.name: RAG Chatbot for E-commerce Product Q&A
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented chatbot that answers product questions for an online store. Uses gte-multilingual-base embeddings, a Qdrant vector database with cosine-similarity semantic search, and Gemini 2.0 Flash for generation.

projects.name: Vietnam News Crawling and Text Classification
projects.description: An end-to-end Vietnamese news pipeline: scraped and cleaned thousands of articles into a structured dataset, engineered TF-IDF features, trained a multi-class XGBoost classifier evaluated on accuracy and F1, and deployed it as a Flask application for real-time inference.

projects.name: Fine-tuned BERT for Vietnamese Sentiment Classification
projects.description: Fine-tuned BERT on the NTC-SCV dataset for Vietnamese sentiment analysis, with the full training pipeline published for reproduction.
